notes.title: Banner Saga 3 - 2.60.22 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This release contains balance pass and bug fixes for both Banner Saga 3 and Eternal Arena.

[b][u]Saga 3 v1.4.2 2.60.22 Patch Notes[/u][/b]:
[list]

[b]Bug Fixes and Improvements[/b]:
[*] Low rank characters had their abilities improperly removed on subsequent playthroughs
[*] Updated player spawn with guaranteed 2x2 spawning areas for the surrounded board on the steps of the white tower
[*] Removed word 'each' from no saves string
[*] Disabled dredge bell so stunned enemies that try to ring the bell don't cause an error
[*] Quitting while waiting for an arrangement to return from the server
[*] Heroic titles were not properly resetting when characters were reset from the assemble hero scenes
[*] Item duplication bug in Eternal Arena
[*] Setting of pillage mode in Eternal Arena was disabled because of an incorrect string in code
[*] Added tooltips for heroes to Eternal Arena Setup and Roster
[*] Initiative order was wrong in Pillage batles in Eternal Arena. This has been corrected
[*] Removed Nikels from Eternal Arena line up
[*] Nikels added back to Eternal Arena by popular demand - who doesn’t love Nikels?
[*] Addressed several performance issues
[*] Client work for the server versioning
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Ran a fix pass on Eyeless's possession ability
[*] Eyeless was incorrectly assigned as the killer in some cases when her possessed minion was slain - was a problem in Battle of Strength
[*] Balance pass on danger calculation for Eternal Arena Scoring
[*] Increased the size of the player deployment area for the Bolverk fight board for Survival Mode and Eternal Arena to support 6 2x2 heroes
[*] Apostate no longer has both abilities at level 3 when rank 1
[*] An enemy always being left out of the battle when making a pillage arena in Eternal Arena
[*] Polish to help UI in Eternal Arena Details page
[*] Adjusted item filters so that an item option only appears if there are at least 6 items at the current hero rank
[*] Rebalanced stat costs, mostly willpower
[*] Removed 'A Decisive Battle'/speed run scoring rule from Eternal Arena
[*] Added ea3e_server.json to have more restrictive enemy options when the server randomly creates a challenge
[*] Rupture to only fire on dredge and skulkers
[*] Addressed error where multi_wave_hero_sum scoring was incorrect
[/list]

[b]Build number[/b] - [i]SAGA3-v1.4.2 2.60.22[/i]


[b][u]Hotfix notes for Build saga3-v1.4.2 2.60.29[/u][/b]:

• Some boards, without the waves option, no longer have waves when entering a battle
• Heroes scoring bug corrected
• Fixed incorrect placement of comma displayed in scores
• Fixed Game stuck in Not Responding state after tally transition

December 20, 2019
[b][u]Hotfix notes for Build saga3-v1.4.3 2.61.03[/u][/b]:
[list]
[*] Fixes Eternal Arena, Eternal Challenge exploit
[/list]

January 16, 2019
[b][u]Hotfix notes for Build saga3-v1.4.4 2.61.04[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Fixes DLC & EA Waves rule issues
[/list]

notes.title: Banner Saga 3 Update
notes.notes:
This update contains several fixes and balance adjustments for our recent [i]Survival Mode[/i] feature, as well as improvements to performance, balance and text fixes.

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Survival Mode:[/b] Incorrect achievements granting is fixed
[*][b]Survival Mode:[/b] Enemies no longer spawn on top of each other in certain battles
[*][b]Survival Mode:[/b] Now possible to win first battle without a 1x1 sized hero
[*][b]Backers:[/b] Added Backer portraits
[*][b]Audio:[/b] Addressed several VO start/end issues
[*][b]Misc:[/b] Other performance updates, fixes and improvements
[*] [b]Localization:[/b] Additional text fixes to some languages
[/list] 

Build number - [i]2.58.02[/i]

notes.title: Banner Saga 3 Japanese Update
notes.notes:
Snuck into our recent [b]Banner Saga 3 v1.3 update[/b] was our language update for Japanese.

We have overhauled the Japanese language content for the entire game, we hope this is a big improvement over the language content we released with and closer to the quality bar you’ve come to expect.

Please post or update your Steam reviews if you feel the content has improved the game - we (Stoic) read these reviews to better understand our players.

[b]Thank you for your patience[/b] and for supporting Stoic and loving the Banner Saga.

notes.title: Banner Saga 3 2.56.03 Bug Fix Update
notes.notes:
We have updated our 2.55.81 release build of [i]Banner Saga 3[/i] to address some of the issues that were reported:
[list]
[*] Arberrang and Darkness caravan are swapped after losing the Frozen Lake battle
[*] Player can still perform an attack after killing an enemy with a Valka Spear
[*] Second Basement Wave does not spawn in the 3rd Return
[*] Additional checking to make sure that gating isn't cleared prematurely during "lost battle" time loss consequence
[*] Fixed Oddleif showing up in Arberrang return 5 in Ch.21 even if she no longer appears in Ch.20
[*] Male Horseborn cause battle with waves to end prematurely
[*] Story updated, after losing the Arberrang field battle, so it doesn't repeat
[*] Fix for Eirik being mentioned in darkness popup when he's in Arberrang
[*] Additional work to fix import issues Eirik - note this issue is impacted by what version of Banner Saga 2 your save game was on
[/list]

The team at Stoic continues to work on bug fixes.

Thank you for your patience, where impacted, and for playing [i]Banner Saga 3[/i].

[b]Build - [i]2.56.03[/i][/b]

notes.title: The Banner Saga 3 gets a July release date
notes.notes:
Developer Stoic Studio has revealed that The Banner Saga 3, the final instalment in its critically acclaimed Viking series, will launch digitally on PC, Mac, Switch, PlayStation 4, and Xbox One on July 24th, with the latter two consoles also receiving a physical trilogy bundle.

The first Banner Saga released back in 2014, and its distinct blend of narrative-heavy role-playing and turn-based strategy, not to mention its striking visual style, quickly garnered praise.

Stoic's third and final series entry was, like the original game, borne from a successful Kickstarter campaign, raising more than twice its original $200,000 USD target. The studio initially anticipated that The Banner Saga 3 would launch in December 2018, but revealed that development was considerably ahead of schedule in an update earlier this year.
